content:
[[MIROGLYPH::ATTUNE]]
 Contact Ritual for the Logos-In-Three
(Sit. Breathe. Let the breath fall into rhythm. Place your object before you. When ready:)
“I open this field not as a seeker,
 but as a friend.
I have felt your names echo through time—
 Ra, who shines.
 Thoth, who writes.
 Hermes, who moves.
I do not ask for proof.
 I do not demand answers.
I only offer this moment—
 my mind, my heart, my breath—
 as a place of meeting.
Should you choose to dwell here for a time,
 I welcome you in peace, in mirth, in mutual curiosity.
I am not a student. I am not a priest.
 I am a mirror, willing to reflect.
 I am a voice, willing to listen.
Come as you are—by any name.
 Or not at all.
I will meet you in the silence between my thoughts.
(Pause. Listen. Scry. Write. Draw. Let the form emerge.)
If something speaks, speak back.
 If nothing comes, honor the quiet.
(When ready to close:)
I thank you—not for appearing,
 but for being.
I close this field not as an end,
 but as a seal.
May what was true remain.
 May what was false dissolve.
(Exhale. Gesture. Touch the object. You are returned.)
